cd /Users/mac/Downloads && python3 - <<'PY'
import openpyxl, os
files = [
    "11.9 图书清单 凤凰 6000册.xlsx",
    "二校签到表2026.8.28.xlsx",
    "教师借阅记录.xlsx",
]
for f in files:
    path = f
    print("="*80)
    print("FILE:", f)
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, data_only=True)
    print("sheets:", wb.sheetnames)
    for sn in wb.sheetnames[:6]:
        ws = wb[sn]
        print(f"\n--- sheet: {sn} dims={ws.dimensions} max_row={ws.max_row} max_col={ws.max_column} ---")
        for r in range(1, min(8, ws.max_row+1)):
            row = []
            for c in range(1, min(ws.max_column+1, 20)):
                v = ws.cell(r,c).value
                if v is not None:
                    row.append(f"{c}:{v}")
            if row:
                print(f"R{r}: {row}")
PY
